data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig assessed Mattis Musterwadern's 2025 income tax and found a refund (Guthaben) of €654.00, to be transferred to his bank account. The letter also explains the one-month deadline to file an objection (Einspruch) if he thinks the assessment is wrong.
data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025. Based on your income, deductible work expenses and special expenses, the Finanzamt calculated a refund of €654.00, which it will pay into your bank account automatically - no action needed for that. If you think any figure is wrong (e.g. the training costs they recognized), you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app will show you the deadline to decide by. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final after that date.
data.tax_note: This is the tax assessment itself for the 2025 tax year; keep it for your records. It also recognizes your Techniker training (Fortbildung) as deductible work expenses (Werbungskosten), which may be relevant evidence for future filings.

remedy.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.

items.title: Object to the tax assessment if you think it's incorrect (Einspruch)
items.action: If you believe any figure in the assessment is wrong, file a written or electronic objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig, or declare it on record there, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the assessment becomes final and you can no longer challenge it.
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.

items.title: Receive income tax refund (Steuererstattung)
items.action: No action needed - the Finanzamt will transfer the refund to your bank account automatically.
